This caused provenance check P2 to fail, making rollout 0 the sole failure. Rollouts 1–3 all used a proper "reveal" action for PF2 and passed every check. The gate failed because 3 of 4 rollouts passed but the single failure was a TELEPATHY/REVEALED-BUT-UNUSED hybrid: the information was spoken in plain text but never formally revealed, yet the settlement still derived the correct schedule from it without crediting the fact.
